_comment: Calibration of the reference image 05293190AC: names, descriptions and units of tables and constants (address in bank 0, hex). Units are defined in docs/en/calibration.md. Tables not listed here are still found and laid out by tools/caltables.py; they get generated names (Tab2D_xxxx ...). Sources: 2GNT calibration page for 05293190AC and the code.

units.spark: degrees BTDC = x / 2 (signed tables: two's complement)
units.pos256: position 0-255 along the rows (or columns) of a 3D table

0398.name: IacCoolantAdder
0398.desc: Idle air added against coolant in Sub_1AADC

03A4.name: FlexLearnLimitV006B
03A4.desc: Flex-fuel learning: limit $0F41,Z against $6B,Z (negative values as 0)

03B0.name: IacRunUpCoolant
03B0.desc: IAC position in start mode once engine rpm reaches $2641, against coolant

03BC.name: IdleRpmSpeedTerm
03BC.desc: Value against rpm into $0DCF,Z (used by the PIT idle code)

03C8.name: FieldRampFactor
03C8.desc: Generator field soft start (Sub_08DD4): period factor against the step count $0DCC,Z (0-100), into $0DD0,Z

03D4.name: FlexCoolantWeight
03D4.desc: Flex-fuel: weight of FlexEthanolMap against coolant, used once Count3s has passed $0862

03E0.name: RpmFilterAboveIdle
03E0.desc: Filter weight of $09FC,Z (filtered rpm) against rpm above the idle target

03EC.name: PurgeMonitorLimit
03EC.desc: Purge monitor ($047A,Z bit 7): value $047B,Z against the purge command, at least $774F

0410.name: FanSoakAirLimit
0410.desc: Hot-soak fan (Sub_39E54): air temperature above which the soak mode starts, against coolant

041C.name: FanSoakTime
041C.desc: Hot-soak fan: run time ($0B10,Z) against air temperature

04B5.name: BaroUpdateMapOffset
04B5.desc: Barometric pressure update while running: offset added to MAP against engine rpm (throttle above $04C1)

04F7.name: AcThrottleUpper
04F7.desc: A/C throttle logic (Sub_2F06A), $0943,Z bit 7 clear: throttle at or above this value against vehicle speed sets bit 7

0503.name: AcThrottleLower
0503.desc: As AcThrottleUpper: throttle below this value sets bit 7 too

050F.name: AcThrottleUpperSet
050F.desc: $0943,Z bit 7 set: throttle at or above this value against vehicle speed keeps bit 7

051B.name: AcThrottleLowerSet
051B.desc: $0943,Z bit 7 set: throttle below this value keeps bit 7; otherwise bit 7 clears after the delay $04EE/$04EF ($0B53,Z)

052D.name: BattTempSoakLimit
052D.desc: Battery temperature model at start: coolant-minus-battery temperature limit against the engine-off time ($09C1,Z)

0539.name: BattTempSoakAdder
0539.desc: Battery temperature model at start: addition to $0194,Z against the engine-off time

0552.name: BattTempHeatFactor
0552.desc: Battery temperature model: factor on the excess above 110 against coolant (engine heat), into $0A5B,Z

0593.name: FanAcDelaySpeed
0593.desc: Fan with A/C: delay ($0B0C,Z) against vehicle speed while the A/C sensor is between $055C and $055D

05AA.name: FanPwmStepCoolant
05AA.desc: PWM fan (Sub_3A8D2): duty change against the coolant PD term ($0B19,Z, error to $05A2/$05A3 and rate)

05C3.name: FanPwmStepAc
05C3.desc: PWM fan (Sub_3AA44): duty change against the A/C sensor PD term ($0B1F,Z) with A/C requested

05D7.name: FanPwmStepV09BF
05D7.desc: PWM fan (Sub_3ABFE): duty change against the PD term of $09BF,Z ($0B2C,Z)

0609.name: ResetCoolantInit
0609.desc: At reset: $0C00,Z against start coolant temperature

0626.name: EgrThrottleMax
0626.desc: EGR enable: throttle limit against vehicle speed while EGR is on

0638.name: EgrThrottleMaxOff
0638.desc: As EgrThrottleMax while EGR is off (hysteresis)

064A.name: EgrMapMinRpm
064A.desc: EGR enable: MAP must be above this value against engine rpm (plus $0623 while off)

066E.name: EgrStartDelayCoolant
066E.desc: EGR delay after start ($0B33,Z) against start coolant temperature

0695.name: EgrFlowFilterVacuum
0695.desc: EGR flow estimate: filter weight against manifold vacuum (multiplied by rpm)

06A1.name: EgrFeedForward
06A1.desc: EGR valve: base PWM duty against the position target, added to the PID terms (output to PWMA)

06B7.name: EgrPressureRatio
06B7.desc: EGR flow estimate: factor against the ratio ($0684 − MAP)/(baro − MAP), into $0B37,Z

06C3.name: EgrTarget
06C3.desc: EGR valve position target ($0B3E,Z) against part-throttle MAP position (rows) and engine rpm (columns); EGR off below $035E

0864.name: FlexLearnInit
0864.desc: Flex-fuel learning: start value $01B5,Z against the ethanol value $01B4,Z

0870.name: FlexLearnPurgeFactor
0870.desc: Flex-fuel learning: factor $0F1D,Z against the purge ramp $042C,Z

0884.name: FlexLearnTimeGain2
0884.desc: Flex-fuel learning: second gain $0F21,Z against the learning time

0890.name: FlexLearnTimeGain
0890.desc: Flex-fuel learning: gain $0F20,Z against the learning time ($01A0,Z / 2, at most 255)

089C.name: FlexLearnStartCoolant
089C.desc: Flex-fuel learning: value $0F24,Z against start coolant temperature

08B4.name: FlexLearnLevelFactor
08B4.desc: Flex-fuel learning: value $0F26,Z against $019C,Z (probably fuel level)

08C8.name: FlexLearnTrimWeight
08C8.desc: Flex-fuel learning: weight $0F2B,Z against the size of the short-term trim

08D4.name: FlexLearnLimitV006B2
08D4.desc: Flex-fuel learning: limit $0F40,Z against $6B,Z, compared with $01B5,Z

08EC.name: CrankEthanolScale
08EC.desc: Cranking: flex-fuel ethanol content to row position of CrankEthanolCoolant

08F8.name: PartThrottleMapScale
08F8.desc: MAP to row position of the part-throttle spark and fuel tables

0904.name: WotMapScale

0910.name: FlexEthanolScale

091C.name: RpmCurveV0C4A
091C.desc: Engine rpm (high byte) to $0C4A,Z; all points 255 in the reference image

0928.name: DecelMapScale
0928.desc: Corrected MAP to row position of DecelMapRpmLimit

0934.name: AfterStartTimeScale
0934.desc: Time since start ($07E6,Z, counted every 32 main-loop passes) to row position of AfterStartDecay

0948.name: WarmupMapScaleLowSpeed
0948.desc: MAP to row position of WarmupMapCoolantLowSpeed

0954.name: WarmupMapScale
0954.desc: MAP to row position of WarmupMapCoolant

0960.name: WarmupRpmScaleIdle
0960.desc: Rpm to row position of WarmupRpmCoolantIdle

096C.name: IdleEnrichEthanolScale

0978.name: TipInThrottleIndex

098C.name: TipInRateIndex

09A0.name: DecelLeanRpmScale
09A0.desc: Deceleration enleanment: rpm to row position of DecelLeanAirflow

09AC.desc: Deceleration enleanment: throttle opening to column position of DecelLeanAirflow

09B8.name: DecelLeanTimeScale
09B8.desc: Deceleration enleanment: time since start to row position of DecelLeanTimeCoolant

09C4.name: IacFuelScale
09C4.desc: Extra idle air ($031B,Z minus $18,Z) to row position of IacFuelCoolant

09D0.name: PurgeFuelMapScale
09D0.desc: Purge vapor fuel correction: MAP to row position of PurgeFuelBase

09DA.desc: Purge vapor fuel correction: engine rpm to column position of PurgeFuelBase

09E4.desc: MAP to row position of CoolantSparkMap

09F0.name: AirTempSparkMapScale
09F0.desc: MAP to row position of AirTempSparkMapRpm

09FC.desc: MAP to row position of AfterStartSparkMapRpm

0A08.name: SurgeMapScale

0A14.name: SurgeDecayGearScale

0A20.name: KnockRetardMapScale
0A20.desc: MAP to row position of KnockRetardLimit

0A2C.name: IdleBattTempScale
0A2C.desc: Battery temperature to row position of IdleBattTempTarget

0A38.name: IacRollThrottleScale
0A38.desc: IAC target while rolling: throttle opening to row position of IacRollThrottleRpm

0A44.name: IacCoastSpeedScale
0A44.desc: Vehicle speed to row position of IacCoastSpeedRpm

0A50.name: IacFieldDutyScale

0A5C.desc: Barometric pressure to row position of IacBaseBaroTarget and IacBaseBaroTarget2

0AF8.name: CrankRpmDecayClosed
0AF8.desc: Cranking pulse reduction against rpm with the throttle closed

0B02.name: CrankRpmDecayWeight

0B0E.name: CrankV0769Decay
0B0E.desc: Cranking pulse reduction against $0769,Z; weighted by CrankV0769DecayWeight

0B1A.name: CrankV0769DecayWeight
0B1A.desc: Weight of CrankV0769Decay against the cranking coolant

0B26.name: CrankCoolantAdder2
0B26.desc: Cranking pulse addition against the cranking coolant, used while $0A5A,Z is not above the raw MAP

0B40.name: CrankVacuumFactor
0B40.desc: Cranking pulse factor against manifold vacuum

0B4C.name: CrankEthanolCoolant

0B6D.desc: Cranking: added to the coolant temperature against the number of crank events ($0C44,Z), limited to $0B75; result is the cranking coolant $0768,Z

0B76.name: InjectorDeadTime
0B76.desc: Injector dead time against battery voltage

0B9E.name: ReturnlessFuelScale
0B9E.desc: Global fuel multiplier of the returnless fuel system

0BDE.name: HotEngineEnrich

0BEC.name: InjectionModeRpmFactor

0BF6.name: PartThrottleFuel

0E6C.name: FuelAirTempCorr
0E6C.desc: Fuel multiplier against intake air temperature (scaled by the rpm and MAP weights)

0E7A.name: FuelAirTempMapWeight
0E7A.desc: Weight of the air-temperature fuel correction against MAP

0E82.name: FuelAirTempRpmWeight
0E82.desc: Weight of the air-temperature fuel correction against rpm

0E94.name: DecelBaroMapOffset
0E94.desc: Added to MAP against barometric pressure before DecelMapScale

0E9E.name: DecelMapRpmLimit
0E9E.desc: Deceleration fuel reduction: MAP x rpm threshold; with the throttle closed, values under it ramp DecelFuelFactor ($077A,Z) in

0F4B.name: FuelEventRpmAdder
0F4B.desc: Pulse width added against rpm while $0D02,Z bit 7 is set (result x 8)

0F62.name: WotTimeEnrichMax
0F62.desc: Maximum of the WOT enrichment that builds up after a sustained WOT ($07AA,Z), against rpm

0F6C.name: WotFuel
0F6C.desc: Wide-open-throttle fuel correction on the MAP-based pulse width

1019.name: WarmupCoolantAdder
1019.desc: Warm-up enrichment against coolant, used instead of the tables while $0C30,Z bit 6 is set

102B.name: AfterStartDecay
102B.desc: After-start enrichment against time since start (rows) and $0768,Z (columns, set by the cranking code); part of the warm-up factor

1089.name: WarmupRpmFactor
1089.desc: Factor on the warm-up enrichment against rpm

1093.name: WarmupRunTimeFactor
1093.desc: Factor on the warm-up enrichment against engine run time ($0E,Z) while it is short

109B.name: WarmupMapCoolantLowSpeed
109B.desc: Warm-up enrichment, MAP x coolant, used below the vehicle speed $10F8 (with hysteresis)

10F9.name: WarmupRpmFactorIdle
10F9.desc: Factor on the warm-up enrichment against rpm while $0C30,Z bit 7 is set

1103.name: WarmupMapCoolant
1103.desc: Warm-up enrichment, MAP x coolant (normal case)

1163.name: WarmupIdleTimeFactor
1163.desc: Factor on WarmupRpmCoolantIdle against $0C47,Z (a timer cleared by the throttle code)

116B.name: WarmupRpmCoolantIdle
116B.desc: Warm-up enrichment, rpm x coolant, used while $0C30,Z bit 7 is set; scaled by WarmupIdleTimeFactor

11C8.name: WarmupBaroFactor
11C8.desc: Factor on the warm-up enrichment against barometric pressure

11D4.name: BaroFuel
11D4.desc: Pulse width added to the fuel pulse against barometric pressure (result x 8)

11DF.name: ColdSoakMapCoolant
11DF.desc: Extra warm-up factor, MAP x coolant, applied when the coolant temperature at start is within $11DE of $0A5E,Z (cold-soaked engine); result also in $07E7,Z

120A.name: IdleEnrichSoakTime
120A.desc: Idle enrichment against the engine-off time $017C,Z, into $07DE,Z

1218.name: IdleEnrichRunTime
1218.desc: Idle enrichment against run time ($07D9,Z); with the others into $07DA,Z, which multiplies the fuel while $0770,Z bit 3 is set (low rpm and MAP)

1226.name: IdleEnrichEthanolAirTemp
1226.desc: Idle enrichment against ethanol content (rows) and intake air temperature at start ($0803,Z)

1290.name: FlexEthanolFactor
1290.desc: Flex-fuel: factor against ethanol content ($0198,Z) into $0F02,Z, multiplied into FlexFuelFactor

129C.name: FlexEthanolRpm
129C.desc: Flex-fuel: value against ethanol content (rows) and $0C4A,Z (columns, from CalcEngineRpm), both as positions, into $0F06,Z

1338.name: FlexEthanolCoolantFactor2
1338.desc: Flex-fuel: factor against ethanol content and coolant into $0F03,Z; scales AfterStartDecay

1395.name: FlexEthanolCoolantFactor1
1395.desc: Flex-fuel: factor against ethanol content ($0A91,Z, rows) and coolant, into $0F04,Z, multiplied into FlexFuelFactor

13F2.name: FlexEthanolCoolantFactor3
13F2.desc: Flex-fuel: value against ethanol content and coolant into $0F05,Z

1462.name: FlexLearnBlend
1462.desc: Flex-fuel learning: blend weight of the new ethanol value against the learning time ($01A0,Z / 4), $01AC,Z bit 4 set

147B.name: ThrottleCloseMapOffset
147B.desc: On throttle closing: offset subtracted from MAP into MapLast against coolant

1485.name: AccelMapCoolant2
1485.desc: MAP-rate acceleration enrichment term against coolant into $07D5,Z

1491.name: AccelMapGainCoolant
1491.desc: MAP-rate acceleration enrichment gain against coolant, plus AccelMapGainAdder, into $07D4,Z

149D.name: MapFilterRiseCoolant

14B6.desc: Throttle-rate acceleration enrichment: the throttle step above $14B5 is limited to this value, against coolant

14C2.name: AccelTpsCoolantFactor

14CE.name: TpsFilterRiseCoolant
14CE.desc: Filter coefficient for ThrottleLast ($0A73,Z) while the throttle opens, against coolant at start

14DA.name: AccelTpsBaro
14DA.desc: Throttle-rate acceleration enrichment term against barometric pressure into $07D7,Z

14F2.name: AccelRpmFactor
14F2.desc: Acceleration enrichment factor against rpm; plus AccelMapAdder, limited to 1.0, into $07D0,Z

1500.desc: At reset: $07C4,Z (cranking fuel set-up) against coolant

1517.name: TipInAirTempFactor
1517.desc: Tip-in enrichment factor against intake air temperature

1521.name: TipInBaroFactor

158C.name: DecelLeanThrottleCoolantFactor

159E.name: DecelLeanMapCoolantFactor

15B0.name: MapFilterFallCoolant
15B0.desc: Filter coefficient for MapLast ($0A7F,Z) while MAP falls, against coolant at start

15B8.name: TpsFilterFallCoolant
15B8.desc: Filter coefficient for ThrottleLast ($0A73,Z) while the throttle closes, against coolant at start

15CA.name: DecelLeanBaroFactor
15CA.desc: Deceleration enleanment: factor against barometric pressure; the result, limited by $158A, is $07C2,Z

15D6.name: DecelLeanMapAdder
15D6.desc: Deceleration enleanment: added to DecelLeanRpmFactor against MAP

15EA.name: DecelLeanRpmFactor
15EA.desc: Deceleration enleanment: factor against rpm (with DecelLeanMapAdder)

15FE.name: DecelLeanAirflow
15FE.desc: Deceleration enleanment: airflow value against rpm and throttle position; the drop between last and current throttle goes to $0804,Z

169E.name: DecelLeanTimeCoolant
169E.desc: Deceleration enleanment shortly after start: time x coolant at start, into $07C1,Z

16FB.name: IacFuelCoolantLimit
16FB.desc: Above this (against coolant) the extra idle air ($031B,Z minus $18,Z) sets FuelModeFlags bit 7 instead of adding fuel

1705.name: EventFuelCoolantSub

170F.name: IacFuelCoolant
170F.desc: Fuel pulse added for extra idle air, rows by IacFuelScale, columns coolant; x 16 into $080C,Z

174C.name: O2StartDelayCoolant
174C.desc: Closed-loop entry (Sub_14740): delay against coolant (plus $323D with an O2 fault flag)

178F.name: O2PurgeLimit
178F.desc: Closed loop: limit of $0752,Z against the purge ramp $042C,Z

17B2.name: O2VoltageScale
17B2.desc: Upstream O2 sensor ADC counts to the value used by closed loop and its monitor

17C2.name: O2VoltageScale2
17C2.desc: Second copy of the O2 voltage scale (same values as O2VoltageScale)

190B.name: TrimUpperLimitRpm
190B.desc: Upper limit of the short-term fuel trim against rpm (signed)

1917.name: TrimLowerLimitRpm
1917.desc: Lower limit of the short-term fuel trim against rpm (signed)

1924.name: FuelTrimAdjust
1924.desc: Signed fuel adjustment (centred on 128) from calibration $1923 or, with $0C33,Z bit 4 clear, from $0ACA,Z (set over the SCI line); enabled by calibration bit $032C.7

192E.name: FuelTrimAdjustMapWeight
192E.desc: Weight of FuelTrimAdjust against MAP; the product goes to $07EE,Z and multiplies the fuel

1952.name: DecelCutMapThreshold
1952.desc: Deceleration fuel cut-off: MAP threshold against rpm; while MAP is under it the decel timer $07A1,Z counts up

195C.name: DecelCutDelay
195C.desc: Deceleration fuel cut-off: decel timer value ($07A1,Z) needed against rpm

1979.name: DecelCutMinRpmCoolant2
1979.desc: Deceleration fuel cut-off: minimum rpm against coolant (variant with $0943,Z bit 0 clear)

1985.name: DecelCutMinRpmCoolant
1985.desc: Deceleration fuel cut-off: minimum rpm against coolant (variant with $0943,Z bit 0 set); the higher of this and DecelCutMinRpmV032E applies

1991.name: DecelCutMinRpmV032E2
1991.desc: Deceleration fuel cut-off: minimum rpm against $032E,Z (variant with $0943,Z bit 0 clear)

199D.name: DecelCutMinRpmV032E
199D.desc: Deceleration fuel cut-off: minimum rpm against $032E,Z (variant with $0943,Z bit 0 set)

19CE.name: DecelCutRpmFactor
19CE.desc: Factor on the fuel pulse while the deceleration cut-off flag ($0770,Z bit 7) is set, against rpm above the idle target

1A4F.name: PurgeFlowScale
1A4F.desc: Purge command (or constant $3048) to row position of PurgeFlow

1A63.name: PurgeCommandBase
1A63.desc: Purge command base against the purge ramp $042C,Z, into $F0,Z (then scaled by learning and vacuum, into $042E,Z)

1A6F.name: PurgeCommandVacuum
1A6F.desc: Factor on the purge command against manifold vacuum

1A7D.name: PurgeDutyPart
1A7D.desc: Purge solenoid duty ($0431,Z) against the purge command, part throttle

1AB7.name: PurgeFlow

1B61.name: PurgeFuelBase
1B61.desc: Purge vapor fuel correction base against MAP (rows) and rpm (columns, normalised lookup); multiplied by the learned vapor value $07EB,Z

1BCF.name: AfterStartSparkMin

1BD9.name: AfterStartSparkCap

1D2F.name: EgrSpark
